findings.fix: Rotate each named credential, remove the file from the index, and replace it with a keys-only example.

findings.fix: Replace each @vN with the 40-character commit SHA, keep # vN as a comment, and let Dependabot bump the SHAs.

findings.title: Replace the wildcard CORS origin with an explicit allow list
findings.why: Any page on the internet can call the API with the browser's cookies attached, so a logged-in visitor to an unrelated site performs authenticated requests without knowing, and the wildcard combined with credentials is the exact configuration browsers refuse for that reason.
findings.fix: List the origins the API actually serves, and never pair a wildcard with credentials.

findings.title: Remove continue-on-error from steps that gate correctness
findings.why: A failing test suite reports a green check, which is precisely the path this audit exists to close.
findings.fix: Delete continue-on-error, or move a genuinely advisory step into a separate non-required job.

findings.title: Declare least-privilege permissions for GITHUB_TOKEN
findings.evidence: 3 workflow(s) declare no permissions, 2 of them reference secrets
findings.why: With no declaration the token inherits the repository default, so any injected step can push commits or mint releases from inside your own CI.
findings.fix: Add permissions: contents: read at the top of the workflow and widen per job only where needed.

findings.title: Enable Dependabot or Renovate
findings.why: Without a bot a published advisory sits unpatched until someone audits by hand, which across 1,322 repositories means never.
findings.fix: Commit .github/dependabot.yml covering the repo ecosystems plus github-actions.

findings.title: Pin the container base image by digest
findings.why: An untagged or mutable base means today's build and last month's contain different libc and a different CVE set, with no record of which shipped.

findings.title: Set persist-credentials: false on checkout
findings.evidence: checkout keeps the token, then dependencies are installed
findings.why: The token stays in .git/config for every later step, so a malicious postinstall script reads a pushable credential without one ever being passed to it.
findings.fix: Add with: persist-credentials: false, and pass an explicit token only to the step that pushes.

findings.title: Add a non-root USER to the image

findings.fix: Create an unprivileged user, chown what it needs, and end the Dockerfile with USER.

findings.why: A wedged step runs to the six-hour platform default, which on a two-hourly schedule means three runs overlap behind it.
